{"reason": "34 costly switches and 4 stockouts (e.g. medium risk at 2.8/5.3 days cost 195000 each) come from expedite firing only for high risk under 5 days. Changing and to or makes every high risk—or any level under 6 days—take the 35000 always-on-time expedite: cheaper than the 45000 switch and eliminates those stockout rows.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((or (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high)) (< inventory-days 6))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'suggest-alternative-supplier))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
